text:
maria: Heads-up — after the kernel 6.4 rollout this morning in eu-west2 we're seeing a small but growing set of P4 hosts drop GPUs and get evicted from the pool. Start time ~08:12 UTC, currently about 12 hosts affected.

maria: quick dmesg snippet from host p4-103: 
```
[  123.456789] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0 has fallen off the bus.
[  123.456799] NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed! (0x23:0x46:1234)
[  123.457000] nvidia: probe of 0000:3b:00.0 failed with error -16
[  123.457100] pci_bus 0000:3b: busn_res: Could not find resource for pci 0000:3b:00.0
```

deploy-bot: kernel-rollout eu-west2 -> step 4/5 completed at 08:15 UTC (image: linux-6.4.3). Canary hosts: p4-canary-*.

todd: Is this limited to P4s or do we see it on A10s/p8s too?

maria: so far only P4 fleet. A10s in same racks look fine. Evictions correlate with driver probe failures (see dmesg) during resume/attach.

kevin: Could be DKMS vs packaged module mismatch or a change in module params in 6.4. Any modinfo differences?

anya: I pulled the module versions: 
```
/lib/modules/6.4.3/kernel/drivers/video/nvidia.ko -> version: 535.86.10
/boot/vmlinuz-5.15.x had same module name but ABI older.
```
But the error is "fallen off the bus" not just unresolved symbols. Might be PCI link resets.

maria: Also seeing repeated AER reports immediately before NVRM lines: "PCIe link down" and then the GPU disappears. Could be firmware mismatch or BIOS change in the image.

kevin: Any firmware upgrades included in the 6.4 image? I remember we had an optional fw bump for NVLINK on the canaries.

maria: Not that I'm aware of in the image manifest; can check. We did change kernel config to enable upstream ACS patch set which touches IOMMU ordering.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook suggestion: if GPU probe fails during boot, set kernel parameter `pci=realloc` and try `modprobe -r nouveau; modprobe nvidia` after boot. Use with caution in prod.

todd: Temporary mitigation — hold off further rollout and mark pending hosts immutable. Can we throttle scheduler and avoid re-provisioning on affected zones?

kevin: I'll open a quick rollback window for eu-west2 to return to 5.15 images for P4s only. Need oncall approval.

anya: Also let's run a probe test on a stopped host by booting 6.4 with `rd.driver.pre=nvidia` and capturing `journalctl -k` + `lspci -vv`. If link flaps, collect `ethtool -s` and `setpci` outputs.

maria: cost note — we've had ~9 proactive evacuations and 3 forced evicts, estimated ~140 GPU-hours lost so far. Flagging SRE lead.

todd: Approving rollback for eu-west2 P4s. Kevin please run rollback playbook and coordinate with infra windows. Also tag customers on affected capacity.

kevin: Rolling back canary now, will cut region-wide if canary confirms. Starting job: `./provision rollback --region eu-west2 --image linux-5.15.49-p4-safe`

deploy-bot: rollback job queued (id: rb-20240412-773). Will report progress.

anya: For postmortem — capture `dmesg`, kernel config diffs between 5.15 and 6.4, PCIe firmware versions, and exact driver build IDs. Could be interaction between ACS reorder and NV driver probe ordering.

maria: I'll collect logs and open a ticket with NVIDIA (include NVRM output and pci ids). Also tagging @kevin for rollback status.

kevin: RB started, will update in next 20m. If rollback doesn't reduce probe failures we'll escalate to vendor support and consider disabling the kernel patch that changed PCI ordering.

maria: thanks — keeping this thread as single source. I'll post aggregated logs + quick timeline once I have them. :pray:
